reviewer: Claude review of the brain readers’ source labels, the requirement leaves and decoded mesh positions; not a radiologist review
decision: On 2026-11-19 the project owner asked again for the 3D models to be bound. Both evidence ledgers’ stored models were reviewed on 2026-11-18; this pass records and binds the label meshes that the brain readers show and no record covered.
rule: A label mesh is recorded and bound when the reader that shows it is shown in the requirement’s investigation, its own source label names the requirement (own words, another name, or one member of a named group), the leaf is the structure itself, the part the label names, the structure’s own body, or one member of a named group or union, and a stated side agrees with the requirement and with where the decoded mesh lies against the source midline. A whole is not bound to its parts, and a part is not bound to its whole. Coverage is always partial.
method: All 753 label meshes of seven brain readers were compared with the requirement leaves of the investigations that show each reader. Candidates were reviewed by hand; 192 bindings on 186 meshes were accepted. Every other mesh is listed under not_recorded with its reason.
